summary: Rising Mountain tree tower: Franklin listing says built 1913, a Perry listing and a Forestry report say 1909; both register entries say no longer standing.

facts.status_note: Both FFLOS register entries say it is no longer standing.

events.note: 1908-09 Pennsylvania Department of Forestry report says two outlooks were built in May, one on Rising Mountain and fifty feet high. The report is dated 1908-09 and does not give a precise year.

Perry County register entry gives 1909 as the build year for a tree tower. The Forestry report of December 31, 1917 lists a tree observation point 55 feet above the ground, established in 1909 on the Pennypacker Forest.
Franklin County register entry gives 1913 as the build year for a tree tower.
Both register entries say the tower was still used circa 1917.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Franklin entry gives 1913; the Perry entry and the Forestry report give 1909; a 1908-09 report mentions two May outlooks. The sources conflict, and the story reports the dates without choosing one.

The Franklin entry says Franklin County and the Perry entry says Perry County. The history page is headed Perry - Franklin County. The story covers the brief's Franklin record and mentions the Perry entry.

notes_for_editor: The Perry County register entry (US 447) is a second FFLOS record for Rising Mountain that the brief does not list; it may describe the same lookout. The build year and county conflict is unresolved. Brief coordinates (40.21029, -77.66984) are not in the sources (FFLOS says none available) and are unverified. No source describes the site today.
